description.describe_ch: This course presents range of statistical techniques to analyse data. The course focuses on a combination of theory and practice. Excel is used extensively in the course to aid understanding of  complex statistical ideas and to analyse data at a practical level. Students may need a laptop with Microsoft Excel to perform the calculations associated with these statistical techniques. Students will know how to analyze and interpret the results and the output from Excel.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en: Scoring rules: Students have the right to claim when they believe the grades or scores given to them are not the expected ones. Students will be given back the copies in order to ddouble check and make sure  everything is fine.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Whenever students need to delay submitting assignments or cannot attend class, they should notify the teacher via email (in English or Chinese).
Students need to be active and avoid disturbing the class hours. When students fail to abide by the policies, they might suffer consequences. 

For example, students who do not attend to the classes nor do the homework on time for no reason will get 0 point. Plagarism is also 0 point. 
Both L1 and L2 languages are allowed for emails, discussion and assignments.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en: Students should avoid all forms of misconducts such refusal to submit the homework, using the mobile to chat or speak with someone during class.
